sourceTitle: PokéLore curated Pokéathlon Dome shop data

acquisition.method: Purchase for 1,000 Athlete Points on Wednesday or Sunday.
requirements: Available only on Wednesday or Sunday

acquisition.method: Find the hidden Heart Scale by Surfing east of the dock. It is south of the pillar near the small rock.
acquisition.originalLocationText: Rt 32, surf east of the dock. South of the pillar, near the small rock.

acquisition.method: Find the hidden Heart Scale by Surfing east of the Gym, then southeast to the middle of the southernmost sailboat.
acquisition.originalLocationText: Vermillion City, begin surfing east of the gym. Surf Southeast. Heart scale is in the middle of the southernmost Sailboat.

acquisition.method: Find as a possible Rock Smash item on eligible maps other than Cliff Cave and the Ruins of Alph.
acquisition.originalLocationText: Rock Smash on any map other than Cliff Cave, and the Ruins of Alph.

acquisition.method: Steal from wild Luvdisc during swarms after obtaining the National Pokédex. Compound Eyes can improve held-item odds, and Thief can take the Heart Scale.
acquisition.originalLocationText: Luvdisc swarms after getting the National Dex. Use Compound Eyes and Thief to steal Heart Scales from Luvdisc.
